projectState.summary: Branch-scoped candidate identity is approved by Claude and merged locally to main. The single-column id primary key remains; candidate ids are branch-scoped with a deterministic b<hash(branchId)>: prefix, parent ids are scoped, and score/status/develop operations enforce branch ownership. Claude verified cross-branch isolation, same-branch idempotence, explicit/generated id scoping, scoped lineage, and matched diversity A/B in one store. First matched 10-generation A/B: diversity-on was never worse across 5 seeds and beat strict elitism on seed 4242 (0.8654 vs 0.8199). Next likely work: longer/more-seed diversity A/B with tuned reservoir knobs, plus shared client/server modules for duplicated helpers and B2 operators before trusted/untrusted provenance.
